item.title: The Stage is Set - Join Us for the XYSG Grand Finals! 欢迎莅临“写一首歌给你”总决赛现场！🎶
item.description: HEY HWA CHONG!! Come celebrate the magic of music with us! Witness the Top 12 Finalists of 《写一首歌给你》XYSG 2026 battle it out and perform with a live band at the XYSG GRAND FINALS CONCERT 🤩! This high-stakes evening will feature live judging to determine the ultimate champions. Whether you're a student, teacher, parent, or simply a music lover, you're welcome to join us for an unforgettable night of original songs and stunning vocal performances! 🎤🎹 舞台已就绪 —— 欢迎莅临“写一首歌给你”总决赛现场！ 🎶 快来和我们一起庆祝音乐的魔力吧！《写一首歌给你》XYSG 2026 12名入围者将与现场乐队合作，在总决赛音乐会中带来震撼人心的演出 🤩！ 总决赛当晚将进行现场评审与打分，共同见证最终冠军的诞生！无论你是学生、老师、家长，还是纯粹的音乐爱好者，都欢迎前来共襄盛举，度过一个充满原创歌曲与绝佳唱功的难忘夜晚 🎤🎹！ 📅 Event Details 📍 Venue: Hwa Chong Institution (College) Chengyi Auditorium 📅 Date: 31st July (Friday) 🕡 Time: 6:30pm – 9:00pm (Gates open at 6:15pm) 🎫 Admission: FREE and open to the public! 📩 Sign Up Now 🏆 Competition Results & Performing Finalists A massive thank you to everyone who took part in this year’s Songwriting and Singing Competitions. The judges were blown away by the creativity, emotion, and dedication behind every entry! Congratulations to all our winners and finalists! (Please note that only the Top 3 Finalists listed below will be performing live at the Grand Finals) 🎵 Songwriting Competition (创作组) High School Category (中学组) - Top 3 Finalists: 《未来在我胸》– 陈罕过 (4i1) 《藏在回忆里的情书》– 吴栩仪 (206) & 吴千汇 (208) 《人生这一部》– 黄企健 (4O2) & 郭俊锋 (25S6K) Junior College Category (高中组) - Top 3 Finalists: 《星河》– 温凯畯 (26S6T), 卓康磊 (26S6T) & 芮振淏 (26SA12) 《少你一阵风》– 叶文扬 (26S6P), 涂睿麟 (26S7A) & 林志鸿 (26S63) 《五分钟的幻觉》– 刘玄德 (26A12), 林家旋 (26A12) & 卓康磊 (26S6T) 🏅 Commendation Awards (优胜奖) - Not Performing : 《对的时间》– 陈欣睿 (26S75) 《随风》– 郭俊锋 (25S6K) 🎤 Singing Competition (歌唱组) High School Category (中学组) - Top 3 Finalists: 陈罕过 (4i1) 吴思璇 (311) 廖峻磊 (4O2) 🏅 Commendation Awards (优胜奖) - Not Performing : 蓝乙萱 (306), 卢秋安 (3i1) Junior College Category (高中部) - Top 3 Finalists: 黄嘉敏 (25S72) 杨祉媛 (25S79) 郭俊锋 (25S6K) 🏅 Commendation Awards (优胜奖) - Not Performing : 黄梓炘 (26S6N), 吴若琳 (26S62) Let’s come together to cheer on our talented finalists and enjoy a night filled with passion, rhythm, and inspiration. We can’t wait to see you there! 🔥🎵 让我们齐聚一堂，为才华横溢的决赛选手们呐喊助威，尽情享受这个充满激情、旋律与灵感的夜晚。我们不见不散！🔥🎵
